title: Fronted Complement 補語前置句

source.file: Sentence Structure 234 - Fronted Complement 補語前置句.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 234; it is assigned system ID ss235 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Complement + as / though + subject + linking verb + main clause

formulas.formula: Adjective complement + as / though + subject + linking verb + main clause
Noun complement + as / though + subject + be + main clause
Main clause + fronted complement + as / though + subject + linking verb

example: Strange though it seems, the plan may work.
exampleZh: 這項計劃看起來雖然奇怪，卻可能行得通。

examples.en: Strange though it seems, the plan may work.
examples.zh: 這項計劃看起來雖然奇怪，卻可能行得通。
examples.highlight: Strange though it seems, the plan may work.

meaning.zh: 這個結構把補語移到讓步子句前面，以 as 或 though 表達「雖然／儘管」和出乎意料的對比。

rules.zh: 以下部分均可以改變： ● the complement 補語 ● the subject 主語 ● the linking verb 連繫動詞 ● the tense 時態 ● as or though ● the position of the whole concessive clause 整個讓步子句的位置 Therefore, was, he and sentence-initial position are not compulsory. 因此，was、he 和句首位置都不是固定部分。
rules.en: The fixed core is complement + as/though + subject + linking verb. The complement, subject, linking verb, tense, conjunction and position of the concessive clause can vary.

rules.zh: 在這個結構中，as 和 though 均表示「雖然／儘管」。
rules.en: As and though both mean although in this structure.

rules.zh: 在 as／though 後面仍然使用正常的「主語＋動詞」次序。
rules.en: Do not use normal subject-verb inversion after as or though; keep subject + linking verb order.

rules.zh: 補語前置後應使用 as 或 though，不可寫成 Tired although he was。
rules.en: Do not retain although after fronting the complement; use as or though.

rules.zh: 他雖然非常疲倦，但仍繼續工作。） Deeply divided as the members had been, they reached an agreement. （成員之前雖然意見嚴重分歧，但最終達成共識。） Words such as very, extremely, deeply and highly are optional extensions. They are not compulsory parts of the structure. very、extremely、deeply、highly 等程度詞只是可選延伸，並非固定句型的一部分。
rules.en: Degree words such as very, extremely, deeply and highly may remain with the adjective, but they are optional extensions.

rules.zh: 當單數名詞補語被移到最前面時，通常要刪去 a、an 或 the。 Other examples: Beginner as she was, ... Newcomer though he was, ... Leader as Maya was, ...
rules.en: Articles are normally removed from a singular noun complement when it is fronted: “Child though he was”, not “A child though he was.”

rules.zh: 主句所描述的事情，應該與前置補語形成真正的讓步或出乎意料的關係。 Natural: Tired as she was, she continued working. （她雖然疲倦，但仍繼續工作。） Illogical: Tired as she was, she went to bed. Going to bed is an expected result of being tired, so the contrast is weak. 因為疲倦而上床睡覺是正常結果，兩部分沒有明顯的讓步關係。
rules.en: The two clauses must show a genuine concession: the main clause should be surprising or unexpected in view of the fronted complement.

rules.zh: 當讓步子句在前，子句後使用逗號。 When the main clause comes first: He continued, tired as he was. 當主句在前，通常在後置的讓步子句前使用逗號。
rules.en: Punctuation depends on position: use a comma after an initial concessive clause, or before a concessive clause that follows the main clause.

benefits.zh: 把 tired、difficult、strange 等補語放在前面，可以立即突出相關困難或出乎意料的情況。 Compare: Although the plan seems strange, it may work. Strange though the plan seems, it may work. The second sentence places greater attention on how strange the plan seems. 第二句把 strange 放在最前面，令「計劃看起來奇怪」這一點更加突出。
benefits.en: It highlights a surprising description by placing the complement first.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚告訴讀者： 「前面的情況確實存在，但沒有阻止主句中的結果發生。」 Tired as he was, he kept going. （他雖然疲倦，但疲倦並沒有令他停下來。）
benefits.en: It clearly connects a difficulty with an unexpected result and shows that the difficulty did not prevent that result.

benefits.zh: 學生經常反覆以 Although 開始句子。補語前置句提供了另一種準確表達讓步和對比的方法，使 句式不會過度重複。
benefits.en: It gives you another alternative to although and reduces repetitive openings.

benefits.zh: 你可以把讓步子句放在主句之前或之後。 Tired as she was, she finished the report. She finished the report, tired though she was. This flexibility helps you control which information the reader sees first. 這種彈性讓你控制讀者先看到困難，還是先看到主要結果。
benefits.en: It allows the concessive clause to appear before or after the main clause, helping control which information comes first.

benefits.zh: 這個句型特別適合在作文、演說和故事中描述： ● 決心 ● 出乎意料的成功 ● 限制 ● 相反證據 ● 意想不到的行為
benefits.en: It is useful in essays, speeches and storytelling about determination, unexpected success, limitations, opposing evidence and surprising behaviour.

benefits.zh: 這個句型通常比一般的 although 子句稍為正式或帶有文學色彩。它能在不加入冗長解釋的情況 下，使重要對比更加鮮明。
benefits.en: It can make a contrast sound more controlled and expressive because it is somewhat more formal or literary than an ordinary although-clause.
